settings.session_hint: Find your Session ID in the HypeRate app →
settings.color_zone_hint: Heart rate zones are on, so the zone colour replaces this one as soon as a heart rate arrives. Open zones ↗
settings.sessions_confirm: Delete every recorded session? This cannot be undone.
settings.sessions_info_html: Records your heart rate for as long as it is coming in, plus the game moments that happen. Stored on this computer only, and removed once the retention above runs out.
settings.ble_info_html:
Connect any Bluetooth LE heart rate monitor directly — Garmin, Polar, Wahoo, Coospo, and most other straps.
View supported devices ↗
settings.ble_unavailable: Bluetooth unavailable — is it turned on?
settings.ble_signal_lost: No heart rate from {name} — is the strap on?
settings.ble_no_contact: {name} has no skin contact — moisten the electrodes and check the fit
settings.discord_info_html:
Shows your live BPM and active zone name on your Discord profile.
Zone names are taken from your Zones tab — label them however you like.
Requires Discord Desktop to be running.
settings.osc_enable_html: Enable OSC in VRChat: Settings → OSC → Enable
settings.osc_outputs_hint_html: Only enabled outputs are sent. Enter parameter names without /avatar/parameters/. Each enabled output needs a different name.
settings.osc_bool_hint: Sent with each BPM update. No automatic False on disconnect or when disabled.
settings.osc_legacy_hint_html: onesHR, tensHR, hundredsHR as floats. Leave off unless your avatar needs them.
settings.osc_not_saved: Not saved: {error} Previous settings remain active.
settings.osc_sent: ✓ Packet sent — check VRChat avatar parameters!
settings.osc_info_html: Sends /avatar/parameters/HR (int) + onesHR / tensHR / hundredsHR (float) every heartbeat. Enable OSC in VRChat: Settings → OSC → Enable
settings.osc_chatbox_info_html: Sends your BPM to /chatbox/input — shown as text above your avatar's head in VRChat. Use {bpm} as placeholder.
settings.hyperaid_help: Close WoW before installing. To share with your group, enable Share my BPM in the HypeRaid addon.
settings.hyperaid_folder_status: Choose the WoW Forever installation folder.
settings.hyperaid_setup: Install HypeRaid to prepare the local heart-rate feed.
settings.hyperaid_error: Could not write to the WoW folder. Check the path and your permissions.
settings.hyperaid_restart: HypeRaid is ready. Fully restart WoW to load it.
settings.wow_last_write: WoW last wrote to the log {ago}
settings.wow_preview_hint: WoW look active — use the preview buttons in the World of Warcraft card.
settings.wow_advanced_off_html: Advanced Combat Logging is off — without health values there is no CLOSE CALL. Enable it in WoW: /console advancedCombatLogging 1
settings.mqtt_password_lost: Your saved password could not be read on this install. Please enter it once more.
settings.mqtt_local_network: macOS is blocking the connection to your local network. Allow HypeRate Desktop under System Settings › Privacy & Security › Local Network.
settings.mqtt_discovery: Create entities in Home Assistant automatically
settings.mqtt_test_fail: Not connected — check broker and credentials
settings.mqtt_info_html:
Publishes your heart rate and, if zones are on, the current zone with its colour — Home Assistant picks them up on its own. Game events like You Died or Pentakill come along as their own entity, so a light can react to them. The password is stored encrypted by your operating system.
How to set it up ↗
settings.lol_preview_hint: League look active — use the preview buttons in the League of Legends card.
settings.lol_info_html:
Shows your heart rate at pentakills, close calls, deaths and objectives in League of Legends.
Nothing to set up: the game itself provides the data while a match is running — no addon, nothing is changed in the game.
Read the guide ↗
settings.wow_info_html:
Shows your heart rate at boss kills, close calls and deaths in WoW, plus session highlights like your most intense enemy.
Important: enable Advanced Combat Logging once in the WoW settings and type /combatlog after every login.
How to set it up ↗

tray.updateBody: Click to open the release notes.

sessionCard.tagline: Free heart rate overlay · macOS · Windows · Linux

app.live_sub_lost: The connection dropped, HypeRate is reconnecting
app.live_sub_none: No heart rate source connected yet
app.live_quiet_contact: {name} has no skin contact — moisten the electrodes and check the fit
app.live_quiet_signal: No heart rate from {name} — is the strap on?
app.graph_waiting: The graph fills in as your heart rate comes in.
app.graph_label: Heart rate over the last ten minutes
app.empty_none_text: Connect a Bluetooth chest strap or your HypeRate app, and your heart rate shows up here.
app.empty_lost_text: {name} is not sending right now. Is it on and in range? HypeRate keeps trying to reconnect.
app.overlay_hint: Your heart rate on top of any game. Drag it where you want it.
app.todo_text: This page is being moved into the new window. Until then, everything is in the previous window.
app.source_sub: Where your heart rate comes from. You can switch at any time.
app.choice_ble_sub: Chest strap or watch straight to this computer. Fastest, no app needed.
app.choice_cloud_sub: Your watch sends through the HypeRate app on your phone.
app.ble_off: Bluetooth is off or not available. Switch it on, and HypeRate connects again by itself.
app.auto_reconnect_sub: After a drop, sleep or a restart of the app.
app.supported_html: Works with Polar, Garmin, Wahoo, Coospo and most Bluetooth LE heart rate monitors. Supported devices
app.log_empty: Nothing yet. Connect a device and every step shows up here.
app.session_hint_html: Find your session ID in the HypeRate app. No app yet? hyperate.io
app.cloud_error_plain: Could not connect. Is the session ID right?
app.overlay_sub: How your heart rate looks on top of your game. Changes reach the open overlay right away.
app.game_bar_hint: While {games} is running, the overlay turns into the game bar instead. Set it up under Games.
app.zone_replaces_color: Zone colours are on: as soon as a heart rate arrives, the zone colour replaces this one.
app.zones_sub: The colour of the current zone replaces the heart colour.
app.zones_discord: Zone names also show up in Discord.
app.display_single: The overlay shows on your only display.
app.all_spaces_sub: macOS: also on other desktops and over full-screen apps.
app.games_sub: While a supported game runs, your overlay turns into its game bar and shows moments like a boss kill or a pentakill.
app.games_hyperaid_hint: Your heart rate inside World of Warcraft itself (HypeRaid) is under Integrations.
app.wow_moments_sub: HypeRate reads the combat log and opens the bar at boss kills, deaths and close fights — in your overlay, not in the game.
app.lol_moments_sub: During a match the bar opens at pentakills, deaths and objectives — in your overlay, not in the game.
app.preview_real_sub: Shows a sample card in the real overlay
app.test_needs_on: Switch the moments on to try them.
app.bar_size_px: {idle} × {h} px at rest, {open} px wide when a moment opens. Leave room at the top or bottom of the screen.
app.lol_how_html: Nothing to set up: the game itself provides the data while a match runs. No addon, nothing is changed in the game.
app.hyperaid_q: Show your heart rate inside the game?
app.hyperaid_where: The HypeRaid addon is under Integrations.
